app.name: GI Compass
app.tagline: A guided symptom questionnaire, reviewed by a doctor

standingNotice.notADiagnosis: This service does not diagnose. A registered doctor reviews everything you tell us before any result reaches you.
standingNotice.seekCare: If your symptoms are severe or getting worse, do not wait for this review — seek care in person.

home.heading: Tell a doctor what is going on, before you sit down with them
home.intro: Answer a guided set of questions about your symptoms and upload any reports you already have. A registered doctor reviews your answers and writes back with what they think and what to do next.
home.step1Body: The questions adapt to your answers, so you are only asked what is relevant to you. Pictures help where a description is hard.
home.step2Title: Add any reports you already have
home.step2Body: Lab results, endoscopy or scan reports, discharge summaries, prescriptions. A photo of a paper report is fine.
home.step3Title: A doctor reviews it and writes back
home.step3Body: A registered doctor reads your answers, forms an impression, and tells you what they suggest next. Nothing reaches you until they have reviewed it.

auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short phrase you will remember works better than a short complicated word.
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in an hour.
auth.verifySent: Check your email. We have sent a link to confirm your address — it expires in 24 hours.
auth.verifySuccess: Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
auth.verifyFailed: That link is no longer valid. It may have been used already or expired.
auth.adultsOnly: This service is currently for adults. If you are under 18, please see a doctor directly.
auth.mfaBody: Accounts that can see patient records need a second factor. You cannot open a case until this is set up.
auth.mfaSignInBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
auth.mfaScanHeading: Scan this with your authenticator app
auth.mfaScanBody: Use any authenticator app — Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, or your password manager.
auth.mfaQrAlt: QR code for setting up your authenticator app
auth.mfaCannotScan: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand

profile.heading: A few details about you
profile.intro: The doctor needs these to read your answers properly. Your name and phone number are stored encrypted.
profile.dateOfBirthHint: Some questions and safety checks depend on your age.
profile.emergencyContactHint: Only used if your answers suggest you need urgent care.

consent.heading: What you are agreeing to
consent.intro: Each of these is a separate decision. You can say yes to some and no to others, and you can change your mind at any time from your privacy settings.

account_processing.title: Store my answers and my account
account_processing.explanation: We keep what you tell us so a doctor can read it and so you can come back to it. Without this we cannot store anything at all.
account_processing.withdrawal: Your account and everything in it would be closed and deleted.

ai_assisted_analysis.title: Use an AI system to prepare a summary for the doctor
ai_assisted_analysis.explanation: An AI system reads your answers and prepares a structured summary to help the doctor review your case faster. It never decides anything, and you never see its output — the doctor does, and they can disagree with it.
ai_assisted_analysis.withdrawal: Your case still goes to a doctor. They read your answers directly, without a prepared summary.

share_with_assigned_doctor.title: Share my answers with the reviewing doctor
share_with_assigned_doctor.explanation: The doctor assigned to your case can read your answers and any reports you upload.
share_with_assigned_doctor.withdrawal: No doctor can read your case, so it cannot be reviewed.

case.chooseAreaIntro: Pick the one that fits best. You will be asked about other things as we go — you do not need to work out what is wrong.
case.resumeHeading: You have a questionnaire in progress
case.resumeBody: You can pick up where you left off, or start again.
case.branchOpened: Your answer added some follow-up questions.
case.unsavedRetry: We could not save that answer. Check your connection — we will keep trying.
case.incomplete: There are still questions to answer before this can be sent.
case.goToUnanswered: Go to the first unanswered question
case.awaitingReview: A doctor has your answers and will review them. We will email you when they have.
case.noResultYet: There is nothing to show yet. Results appear here once the doctor has reviewed your case.

emergency.heading: Please get medical help now
emergency.contactNotified: Your emergency contact has been told.
emergency.acknowledge: I understand — let me carry on answering
emergency.acknowledgeHint: Your answers are saved either way. Carrying on does not replace getting seen.
emergency.persistentBanner: Your answers suggest you need urgent in-person care. Please do not wait for this review.

documents.heading: Add your reports
documents.intro: Lab results, endoscopy or scan reports, discharge summaries, prescriptions. A clear photo of a paper report is fine.
documents.accepted: PDF, JPG, PNG, or Word. Up to {maxMb} MB each.
documents.typeTag: What kind of report is this?
documents.typeTagHint: A rough answer is fine. It helps even if we cannot read the file.
documents.scanPendingHint: We check every file before your doctor can open it. This one is still being checked.
documents.empty: You have not added any reports yet. This is optional.
documents.tooLarge: That file is larger than {maxMb} MB.
documents.unsupported: We can only accept PDF, JPG, PNG, and Word files.
documents.infected: That file could not be accepted.
documents.cannotDeleteAfterSubmit: This case has been sent to the doctor, so reports cannot be removed. Contact us if something is wrong.

privacy.heading: Your privacy
privacy.rightsIntro: You can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it.
privacy.requestExport: Ask for a copy of my data
privacy.requestErasure: Ask us to delete my data
privacy.erasureWarningBody: This removes your answers, your uploaded reports, and any summary the doctor released. A record of who accessed your data is kept, without your name, because we are required to keep it.
privacy.requestSubmitted: We have your request. We will be in touch.

doctor.redFlagsIntro: Raised by clinician-authored rules before any AI ran. The patient has already been advised.
doctor.assessmentAbsent: No AI summary for this case
doctor.assessmentUngrounded: No curated guidance matched this presentation — this summary is ungrounded.
doctor.impressionHint: This is the only part of the record allowed to state a conclusion. Phrase it as an impression pending anything you need to confirm in person.
doctor.patientSummaryHint: Write this for the patient, in your own words. It is what they see.
doctor.releaseConfirmBody: This is exactly what they will see. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
doctor.noPrescribing: Prescribing is not part of this system. Write any prescription in your own system.
doctor.unassignedIntro: These were submitted with no doctor assigned. Claim one to take responsibility for reviewing it.

admin.heading: Clinical content
admin.previewIntro: Walk the questionnaire exactly as a patient would, including branching and red-flag escalation. Nothing is saved.
admin.imageUnattributed: Not publishable — source and licence missing
admin.previewAgeHint: Age-dependent rules only fire once age is known.

problem.breached: That password appears in known password leaks. Please choose another.
problem.contains_email: Please do not use part of your email address in your password.

error.forbidden: You do not have access to that.
error.consent_required: You need to agree to this before we can continue.
error.invalid_request: Something in that was not right.
error.illegal_transition: That is not possible at this stage.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
error.unavailable: Something is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
error.internal: Something went wrong at our end.
error.audit_unavailable: We could not record that safely, so nothing was changed. Please try again.
error.mfa_required: Set up your second factor first.
error.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection.

auth.login.invalid_credentials: That email address and password do not match.
auth.login.unverified: Please confirm your email address first. Check your inbox.
auth.login.suspended: This account is not active. Please contact us.
auth.login.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.verify.invalid_token: That link is no longer valid.
auth.reset.invalid_token: That reset link is no longer valid. Please ask for a new one.
auth.refresh.replay_detected: For your security we signed you out of every device. Please sign in again.
case.create.unverified_account: Please confirm your email address first.
case.create.adults_only: This service is currently for adults. If you are under 18, please see a doctor directly.
case.create.date_of_birth_required: Please add your date of birth first.
case.create.unknown_entry_point: That option is no longer available.
case.create.draft_already_open: You already have a questionnaire in progress.
case.answers.not_editable: This case has been sent to the doctor, so answers cannot be changed.
case.answers.rejected: That answer could not be accepted.
case.submit.incomplete: There are still questions to answer.
case.submit.already_submitted: This case has already been sent.
case.submit.doctor_sharing_required: A doctor cannot review your case unless you agree to share it with them.
documents.upload.unsupported_type: We can only accept PDF, JPG, PNG, and Word files.
documents.upload.mismatched_extension: That file's name does not match what is inside it.
documents.upload.infected: That file could not be accepted.
documents.upload.case_not_editable: This case has been sent, so reports cannot be added.
review.finalize.doctor_content_required: Please write your own impression and patient summary before finalizing.
review.finalize.ai_summary_passthrough: The released summary must be your own words, not the AI summary passed through.
review.finalize.contains_treatment: Remove the medication or dose. Prescribing is not part of this system.
review.release.no_review: There is no review to release.
review.release.not_finalized: Finalize the review before releasing it.
auth.mfa.already_enrolled: A second factor is already set up for this account. Contact an administrator to reset it.
auth.mfa.not_enrolled: No second factor is set up yet. Reload this page to start.
auth.mfa.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check your authenticator app and try the current code.
auth.mfa.secret_unreadable: Your second factor cannot be read on this server. An administrator needs to reset it.
doctor.claim.already_assigned: Another doctor has already taken this case.
